training_split: Existing stable query hash split: 464 training, 49 validation, 62 test queries
evaluation_rule: All selected sets are rescored on the SAME unmodified reference graph and default objective; ablated training rewards are not compared as performance metrics
model_selection: Validation reference objective only. Test results are descriptive and do not select production models or parameters. Existing production checkpoint remains unchanged.
statistics: Average each paired query difference across the three fixed seeds; bootstrap query units 10000 times, sign-flip Monte Carlo 20000 times, Holm correction across six full-model comparisons. Query overlap means inferential independence is not established; results are conditional descriptive evidence, not clinical inference.

missing_evidence.rule: Remove observed direct/symptom-target/herb-target entries for selection; score on intact reference. No fabricated edges.

optimality: Exhaustive enumeration of all potentially useful herb subsets up to 8 herbs on each of the 62 unconstrained test queries; identical default reference objective
parser: Explicit developer-authored linguistic fixtures and grammar templates over public symptom names. Report before/after as development regression evaluation, never clinical diagnostic accuracy.
limits: Public graph shared across query splits
No patient records or clinical labels
No claim that a database association is therapeutic benefit
